description: The Absences (excuse submission) workflow: refetch-on-demand data hooks with the privacy-safe name-only embed, member form with private attachment upload, member 'My requests' list, officer inbox with filters and signed-URL attachment preview, StatusBadge, and the officer pending-count nav badge. Privacy-critical (medical certificates). Grounded in design.md FR-4.*, OD-2/OD-5, Data layer -> Profiles-embed rule + useAbsenceRequests/useAbsencePendingCount, Components -> Absences, Error handling. Depends on FEAT-001 (tables/storage policies), FEAT-002 (types, storage/datewindow fns, status tokens), FEAT-003 (nav shell + AbsencesPage slot).
steps: Create src/data/useAbsenceRequests.ts: refetch-on-demand (NOT realtime) exposing { data, status, retry, refetch }, refetching on mount, window focus, and after a mutation. Member mode selects own rows (RLS returns only theirs). Officer mode selects all with the disambiguated embed .select('*, student:profiles!absence_requests_user_id_fkey(name)') — name ONLY, never profiles(*) or email — mapped to studentName; leave reviewed_by unembedded.
Create src/data/useAbsencePendingCount.ts: a head:true, count:'exact' query on status='pending', refetched on nav mount and after officer status changes.

Extend src/data/mutations.ts: createAbsenceRequest(input) writing ONLY member-owned fields (user_id, date_from, date_to, subject_ids, all_classes, reason_category, explanation) and never status/officer_remark/reviewed_by/reviewed_at (DB defaults supply pending); addAbsenceAttachment(meta) uploading each file to supabase.storage.from('excuse-attachments').upload(path, file) AFTER the request row exists, then inserting the attachment row; updateAbsenceStatus(id, { status, officer_remark, reviewed_by }) (officer path); deleteAbsenceRequest(id) (member-while-pending); signedUrlFor(bucket, path, opts?: { download?: string | boolean }) wrapping createSignedUrl(path, SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS, opts) -> { ok, url } or a classified error. On a storage/validation failure leave the request pending (member can delete) and surface which file failed.
Create src/components/StatusBadge.tsx: shared pill for pending/acknowledged/needs_followup using --status-* tokens + an icon + text (never color-only).

Create src/components/AbsenceForm.tsx: CalendarField x2 (validated with isValidRange + DB CHECK backstop), a subjects multi-select + an 'All classes' checkbox (sets all_classes, disables the multi-select), reason <select>, <textarea maxLength=500> with a live counter, a file input accepting up to 3 files validated by validateFile(EXCUSE_MIME, EXCUSE_MAX) with a per-file INDETERMINATE 'Uploading…' indicator (spinner + disabled submit, no percent bar) and inline type/size errors, and the fixed notice 'Attachments are visible only to you and class officers.'. Submit via createAbsenceRequest then uploads + addAbsenceAttachment.
Create src/components/MyAbsenceList.tsx: member 'My requests' list with StatusBadge + officer remark; a delete button shown only while status === 'pending' (RLS is the real gate).

Create src/components/OfficerAbsenceInbox.tsx: all rows ordered created_at desc, client-side filters — status <select>, date-range via rangeOverlaps, subject <select> (a request matches S iff all_classes OR subject_ids contains S), case-insensitive student-name over studentName. Each row opens attachments via signedUrlFor('excuse-attachments', path) (default inline disposition) in a new tab for preview, with an optional 'Save a copy' that re-mints with { download: file_name }; a status <select> + remark <textarea> saved via updateAbsenceStatus, then trigger the pending-count refetch. Per-row busy/error state covers mint latency and denials. (Class-scale volume assumed; no pagination.)

Replace the FEAT-003 placeholder src/components/AbsencesPage.tsx with the real gated page: reads useSession and renders SignInGate when signed out; branches on isOfficer into MyAbsenceList+AbsenceForm (member) vs OfficerAbsenceInbox (officer); owns loading/empty/error states with the existing status/retry pattern.
Wire useAbsencePendingCount into src/components/Nav.tsx's Absences pending badge (hidden when zero or non-officer).
acceptance_criteria: A signed-out visitor sees SignInGate on the Absences page; a member sees the form + their own requests; an officer sees the inbox.
createAbsenceRequest never sends status/officer/review fields; attachments upload only after the request row exists.

Officer inbox filters (status, date-range, subject with all_classes-matches-every-subject, student-name) work client-side; attachments open via a freshly minted signed URL; a wrong path yields an inline access error, not a file.
No profiles embed selects email or profiles(*) — only name.
The officer pending-count badge in Nav shows the count of status='pending' requests and refreshes after a status change.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test` and confirm both pass.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm it passes.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds.
Note: end-to-end privacy enforcement (a second member denied, officer allowed, guessed-path denied) is asserted by the RLS integration suite in FEAT-006 against a live project.
findings:
Absences (privacy-critical) landed. Verification all green: typecheck 0 errors; lint 0 errors (3 pre-existing react-refresh WARNINGS only, in NavProvider/SessionProvider/ThemeProvider — untouched); test 168 passed / 9 skipped (RLS integration still skips as expected, no live backend); build OK. No new runtime dep.

New files:
- src/data/useAbsenceRequests.ts — refetch-on-demand (NOT realtime) hook; { data, status, retry, refetch }; refetches on mount + window focus. Member mode select('*'); officer mode select('*, student:profiles!absence_requests_user_id_fkey(name)') (name ONLY, FK-disambiguated — never profiles(*)/email; reviewed_by left unembedded), mapped to studentName; both ordered created_at desc.
- src/data/useAbsencePendingCount.ts — head:true,count:'exact' on status='pending'; enabled flag (officer-only). Refetches on mount, window focus, and a same-tab window CustomEvent 'absence:pending-changed'. Exports notifyAbsenceStatusChanged() to fire that event after an officer status save (Nav badge and the inbox are sibling trees, so no shared context was added).
- src/components/StatusBadge.tsx — shared pill for pending/acknowledged/needs_followup; icon + text + --status-* tokens (never color-only). Labels: Pending / Acknowledged / Needs follow-up.
- src/components/AbsenceForm.tsx — exports PRIVACY_NOTICE constant ('Attachments are visible only to you and class officers.'). CalendarField x2 (isValidRange gate), subjects multi-select + 'All classes' checkbox (disables multi-select; sends subject_ids=[] when allClasses), reason <select>, <textarea maxLength=500> live counter, up to 3 files via validateFile(EXCUSE_MIME, EXCUSE_MAX) with INDETERMINATE spinner 'Uploading…'/'Submitting…' + disabled submit (no percent bar). Submit = createAbsenceRequest -> per-file buildStoragePath + addAbsenceAttachment; on an attachment failure it names the file and leaves the request pending (onSubmitted still fires so the list refetches).
- src/components/MyAbsenceList.tsx — member list with StatusBadge + officer remark; Delete button only when status==='pending' (RLS ar_delete_member is the real gate).
- src/components/OfficerAbsenceInbox.tsx — all rows ordered desc; client-side filters: status <select>, date-range via rangeOverlaps, subject <select> (all_classes matches EVERY subject OR subject_ids.includes), case-insensitive student-name over studentName. Each row lazy-loads its absence_attachments and opens them via signedUrlFor('excuse-attachments', path, {download:false}) inline in a new tab + a 'Save a copy' that re-mints {download: fileName}; per-row busy/error for mint latency + denial (SIGNED_URL_MESSAGES). Status <select> + remark <textarea> -> updateAbsenceStatus, then onChanged (list refetch) + onStatusSaved (pending-count refetch).
- Modified src/components/AbsencesPage.tsx — real gated page: SignInGate when signed out; MemberView (AbsenceForm + MyAbsenceList, member-mode read) vs OfficerView (OfficerAbsenceInbox, officer-mode read) by isOfficer; loading/empty/error with status/retry; subjects via useSubjects.
- Modified src/components/Nav.tsx — wired useAbsencePendingCount(isOfficer); badge rendered after the Absences label, hidden when non-officer or count<=0 (aria-label '<n> pending', --status-pending tokens). Replaced the old NAV_ITEMS `badge` slot with a badgeFor(page) function.

mutations.ts additions (same classify/MutationResult contract, trust RLS):
- createAbsenceRequest(input) -> CreateAbsenceResult { ok, id? }; writes ONLY user_id/date_from/date_to/subject_ids/all_classes/reason_category/explanation, .select('id').single() to return the new id; NEVER status/officer_remark/reviewed_by/reviewed_at (DB defaults supply pending).
- addAbsenceAttachment({requestId,path,file,fileName,mimeType,sizeBytes}) -> storage.from('excuse-attachments').upload(path, file, {contentType}) THEN insert the attachment row (only after the request row exists; ea_insert needs the pending parent).
- updateAbsenceStatus(id, {status, officerRemark, reviewedBy}) -> sets status/officer_remark/reviewed_by + reviewed_at=now() (officer path, ar_update_officer).
- deleteAbsenceRequest(id) -> delete (ar_delete_member own+pending window; UI hide is convenience).
- signedUrlFor(bucket, path, opts?:{download?:string|boolean}) -> SignedUrlResult {ok,url}|{ok,error}; wraps createSignedUrl(path, SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS, opts); classified error, never leaks path/partial URL. Exports SIGNED_URL_MESSAGES.

IMPORTANT CROSS-FEATURE FIX: src/lib/types.ts AbsenceReason was 'school_activity' (FEAT-002 typo) but the 0003 DB enum is 'school_related_activity'; sending the old literal would FAIL the enum on every member submit. Changed the union literal to 'school_related_activity' to match the DB. FEAT-006 and the RLS tests (FEAT-006) must use 'school_related_activity' for the reason category. No other code referenced the old literal.

Added a `@keyframes spin` to src/styles/base.css (indeterminate upload/busy spinner); the existing prefers-reduced-motion guard already neutralizes it.

For FEAT-006 (reviewers): reuse signedUrlFor('reviewers', path, {download: fileName}) and the same classify/MutationResult + SIGNED_URL_MESSAGES pattern; follow the identical name-only profiles embed rule (uploader:profiles!..._fkey(name)). The Nav badge slot is now a function, not a static NAV_ITEMS field.

NOT in scope / not done here: live RLS/privacy enforcement is proved by the FEAT-006 integration suite against a live project (second-member-denied, officer-allowed, guessed-path-denied), not locally.
